Definition: to twinkle, i.e. glance; by analogy, to blossom (figuratively, flourish)
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, tsûwts means to blossom, to flourish. In Numbers 17:8, bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds, and it appears again in Psalms 72:16.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsûwts still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
